prompt.text:
Implement an in-memory appointment command service in `solution.rs` using only the standard library.

Expose:

- `pub struct Appointment { pub id: String, pub title: String, pub date: String, pub notes: String }`
- `pub enum CatalogCommand { List, Create(Appointment), Replace(Appointment), Fetch { id: String } }`
- `pub enum CatalogReply { Listed(Vec<Appointment>), Stored(Appointment), Found(Appointment) }`
- `pub enum CatalogError { EmptyId, EmptyTitle, AlreadyExists, NotFound }`
- `pub struct AppointmentCatalog`
- `AppointmentCatalog::new() -> Self`
- `AppointmentCatalog::execute(&mut self, command: CatalogCommand) -> Result<CatalogReply, CatalogError>`

Derive `Debug`, `Clone`, `PartialEq`, and `Eq` for all public data types and implement `Default` for `AppointmentCatalog` consistently with `new`.

IDs and titles are invalid only when empty; other strings may be empty. `Create` inserts only when the ID is absent. `Replace` changes the entire stored appointment only when the ID already exists. `Fetch` and `List` do not mutate state. `List` returns owned clones sorted by ascending ID. Failed commands must leave the catalog unchanged. Returned appointments must not alias internal storage, so callers may freely mutate their owned replies.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
